timeline.text: A robotic voice reading your lesson breaks the mood before the lesson even starts.
mini.vitalii.no's Norwegian narration now runs on Google's Chirp 3 voices, closer to a real newsreader.
But free voice quotas run dry some months.
So instead of failing, a busy month just quietly drops that clip back to the older voice, like a stand-in stepping onto the stage.
The good voice plays by default, and a rough month never means dead air.
